name: OFAC Sanctions List Service
summary: The US Treasury OFAC Sanctions List Service's published list files: the Specially Designated Nationals (SDN) list and the consolidated non-SDN list, in the standard XML and the advanced data-model XML.

user_agent.description: The User-Agent sent with every request; the SLS host rejects requests without one (403). E.g. your application name and a contact.

notes: Free and keyless, but the host answers 403 to requests with no User-Agent header; set OFAC_SLS_USER_AGENT.
These are whole-list XML downloads, not a search API: download once and match locally, and re-download when OFAC publishes changes.
The old www.treasury.gov/ofac/downloads/<file> URLs redirect here.
The XML schemas are at /api/PublicationPreview/exports/XML.xsd (standard files) and /api/PublicationPreview/exports/ADVANCED_XML.xsd (advanced files).

endpoints.name: Download the SDN list (XML)
endpoints.summary: The full Specially Designated Nationals and Blocked Persons list: individuals, entities, vessels and aircraft with aliases, addresses, ids and programs.

endpoints.name: Download the consolidated non-SDN list (XML)
endpoints.summary: All of OFAC's non-SDN sanctions lists in one file, in the same format as SDN.XML.

endpoints.name: Download the SDN list (advanced XML)
endpoints.summary: The SDN list in OFAC's Advanced Sanctions Data Model, with richer structure for identities, features and relationships.

endpoints.name: Download the consolidated non-SDN list (advanced XML)
endpoints.summary: The consolidated non-SDN lists in the Advanced Sanctions Data Model.
